name: SDD Atomic Tasks Template (Explicit RED-GREEN-REFACTOR-SMOKE)
description: Atomic task-based SDD with 76 sequential tasks (TASK-001 to TASK-070 + DESIGN-001 to DESIGN-003) using explicit action verbs (EXECUTE, RUN, COMPILE, SHOW, CONFIRM) and mandatory verification. Each task requires proof of execution to prevent AI from gaming the system. NO vague terms like 'verify', 'check', or 'ensure'. Phase breakdown: 27+22+17+10=76 tasks (includes 3 design tasks).

timeoutConfiguration.rationale: Prevent AI hanging on long-running tests and processes
timeoutConfiguration.implementation: Uses 'timeout' command with bash -c wrapper for better process control
timeoutConfiguration.fallback: If timeout fails, use 'npm test &' with 'sleep X && pkill -f npm' as backup
timeoutConfiguration.helperScript: timeout-helper.sh provides robust timeout with multiple fallback methods

acceptanceCriteria: Design system documented and implemented
